text: ふむ……　レッド　と　いうんだな！

structure.jp: レッド　と　いうんだな！

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.span: レッド　と　いう
patterns.explanation: A name followed by という says what someone or something is called. レッド　と　いう = 'is called Red'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb shows the speaker is taking in or confirming a fact, like 'so it is that...'. いうんだ = 'so you are called'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirming)
patterns.explanation: な at the end is the speaker nodding to himself as he confirms something, common in men's speech. いうんだな = 'so that's what you're called, I see'.
